_comment: Expected storage layout for backend/data/acceptance_worlds.
This file is deliberately OUTSIDE the worlds tree: nothing under
backend/data/acceptance_worlds is ever trusted as configuration.
backend/data/ is gitignored, so config cannot live there either.
layout:
local          - worlds root is a real directory on the internal disk (current state)
drive_symlink  - worlds root must be a symlink into a declared external volume
The worlds tree lives on the internal disk. The 2026-09-27 relocation to
an external Seagate volume was ABANDONED and its destination deleted, so
there is no link_target and no volume block here. Do not reintroduce them
as a pending task: moving the tree is a deliberate operation, not a
pending one, and an interrupted copy leaves a truncated destination that
reads as a valid world.
The guard still understands drive_symlink for a future relocation. Flip
local -> drive_symlink only AFTER the symlink is in place, and declare the
volume identity (mount_point + name + uuid) in the same change: the guard
rejects a plain local directory while drive_symlink is configured, which is
what stops a launcher from silently mkdir-ing a fresh empty world when the
drive is absent. Volume UUID, not name, is the identity check.
Enable with: python -m core.world_storage_guard check
